amauta.title: Amauta

amauta.description: Amauta is Axentra Systems flagship adaptive learning platform engineered for enterprise upskilling and organizational knowledge synthesis. Powered by cognitive ML models, Amauta dynamically adjusts skill pathways based on employee performance data.
